thesis: The site is the first hour of the engagement, done in the browser before any call: three live worksheets give a Frederick owner a real number about their own business, in plain words, and the call is to talk through a number they already hold.

signature.name: Worksheet Grid
signature.summary: Faint squared paper behind every section with cell references (A1, B4, C7) in DM Mono advancing per section; each claim has a dotted-underline footnote opening a plain formula; sample prices are grid rows with Sample tags. Hook: data-sw-signature='worksheet-grid'.

motion.intro: Grid draws in from top-left via clip-path wipe on background; first input receives focus. Under 1.2s, skippable.
stories: Sample monthly report fills five lines one by one on scroll; missing lines circled in orange. Pinned >=640px.
Cell reference advances A1-H8 via IntersectionObserver updating --sw-cell CSS var; active cell highlights green.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0->1), 200ms, on links and buttons.
